title: Incorporators.
bodyText: One or more individuals may act as the incorporator or incorporators of a professional corporation by delivering articles of incorporation to the director for filing.
bodyHtml: [§415A-14.5]  Incorporators.  One or more individuals may act as the incorporator or incorporators of a professional corporation by delivering articles of incorporation to the director for filing. [L 1987, c 135, §107]
